answer: We formulate a decentralized consensus game where validators post a dynamic opportunity-cost bond bound by a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. To forge an identity, an adversary must commit capital traversing a steep economic karst where the cost of stake locking grows exponentially. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix guarantees that any double-sign yields an immediate forfeiture of collateral. Consequently, the expected utility of Sybil multiplication is strictly negative, forcing convergence to a unique Nash equilibrium reminiscent of resilient yarrow growth.
